reasons: The finding is claimed compliant and correctly carries no redline and no counterparty comment, which is the expected output for a compliant classification.

The cited paragraphs (p0084 fee payment, p0065 maintenance at Fee Schedule rates) contain no most-favoured-nation, 'no less favourable', third-party-matching or benchmarking language, so no MFN obligation burdens the Customer — this matches the rule's preferred position.

For this direction-type rule, absence of any Customer-side MFN is properly treated as compliant rather than 'missing', since the rule does not require an MFN clause to exist; the rationale appropriately notes as internal commercial colour that no MFN runs in our favour either.
Deterministic checks are empty and the rendered redline is identical to the original text, consistent with a no-edit compliant finding.
